page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 20.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 160 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across multiple domains. In LLM inference tests using a small 135M model, the server achieves top-tier performance with 10457.59 tokens per second for prompt processing and 366.07 tokens per second for text generation. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 4086.55 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 110.72 GB/sec. CPU performance is supported by advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to a PassMark CPU score of 55980.84.

Given the inclusion of dual NVIDIA H100 GPUs and 480 GB of RAM, this server represents a high-density hardware profile optimized for specialized, resource-intensive workloads. The absence of local storage means users must provision external storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is highly suited for large-scale machine learning, deep learning training, LLM inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science tasks requiring massive parallel processing and substantial memory capacity.
